title: Zero-Shot Instruction Following in RL via Structured LTL Representations
abstract: arXiv:2602.14344v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study instruction following in multi-task reinforcement learning, where an agent must zero-shot execute novel tasks not seen during training. In this setting, linear temporal logic (LTL) has recently been adopted as a powerful framework for specifying structured, temporally extended tasks. While existing approaches successfully train generalist policies, they often struggle to effectively capture the rich logical and temporal structure inherent in LTL specifications. In this work, we address these concerns with a novel approach to learn structured task representations that facilitate training and generalisation. Our method conditions the policy on sequences of Boolean formulae constructed from a finite automaton of the task. We propose a hierarchical neural architecture to encode the logical structure of these formulae, and introduce an attention mechanism that enables the policy to reason about future subgoals. Experiments

translated_title: 基于结构化线性时序逻辑表示的无零样本指令跟随强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.14344v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：我们研究了多任务强化学习中的指令跟随问题，其中智能体必须零样本执行训练中未见过的新任务。在此背景下，线性时序逻辑（LTL）最近被采用作为一种强大的框架，用于指定结构化、时间上延展的任务。虽然现有方法成功训练了通用策略，但它们往往难以有效捕捉LTL规范中固有的丰富逻辑和时间结构。在这项工作中，我们通过一种新颖的方法来解决这些问题，学习结构化任务表示，以促进训练和泛化。我们的方法将策略条件化于从任务的有限自动机构建的布尔公式序列上。我们提出了一种分层神经架构来编码这些公式的逻辑结构，并引入了一种注意力机制，使策略能够推理未来的子目标。实验...
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用分层神经架构和注意力机制来编码线性时序逻辑（LTL）任务的结构化表示，从而在零样本设置下实现强化学习中的指令跟随。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structured representation of linear temporal logic (LTL) tasks using a hierarchical neural architecture with attention mechanism, enabling zero-shot instruction following in reinforcement learning.
